prompt: This EMCDDA report on the risk assessment of 2C-I, 2C-T-2 and 2C-T-7 is cited for the items below. Report each exactly as printed, and say 'not found' for any that is absent: (a) how 2C-I powder seized or found in Sweden is described (for example its colour); (b) the year of publication of the report; (c) when the 2C-T-7 product 'Blue mystic' began to be sold in Dutch smartshops. Do not quote any passage longer than 15 words.
answer:
**(a)** 2C-I powder in Sweden is described as "in the form of a white powder" (Chapter 2, footnote 8, referring to seizures in the first half of 2003).

**(b)** The report was published in 2004. The cataloguing line reads: "Luxembourg: Office for Official Publications of the European Communities, 2004."

**(c)** "In early 2000, 2C-T-7 began to be sold in smartshops in the Netherlands" under the brand name "Blue mystic" (Chapter 1, 2C-T-7 section).
